event_summary: A hand-held shiny circular disc is cut with scissors from its central opening to its outer edge, and a sector-shaped piece separates.
raw_event_description: A shiny circular disc with a central hole is held over a teal fabric surface by a left hand while a right hand operates scissors. The scissor blades are positioned through and across the central opening, then advance diagonally across the disc. A visible slit lengthens from the central opening toward the outer rim. As the cut progresses, a sector-shaped portion near the upper side tilts away from the rest of the disc. Near the end, the slit reaches the outer edge, the sector-shaped piece separates, and the scissors move away to the right.

reasons: The disc, hands, and scissors are visible at the start.
The scissors are already positioned at the disc's central opening.
The disc surface and central opening are clearly visible.

evidence_bank.observation: A shiny circular disc with a central opening is held over a teal fabric surface by a left hand.
A pair of scissors extends from the right side toward the disc's central opening.
One scissor blade lies across the central opening of the disc.
A right hand grips the black handle of the scissors.
The scissor blades advance diagonally from the central opening across the disc surface.
A narrow diagonal slit is visible in the disc along the path of the scissors.
The visible slit lengthens toward the outer rim of the disc.
A sector-shaped portion of the disc near the upper side tilts away from the rest of the disc.
Rainbow-colored reflections shift across the disc surface as the disc and scissors positions change.
The diagonal slit reaches the outer edge of the disc.
A curved sector-shaped piece is visibly separated from the remaining disc.
The remaining disc shows a large wedge-shaped missing area between the central opening and the outer rim.
The scissors move away to the right after the piece separates.
